name: Kasubi Tombs
description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and burial grounds of Buganda kings showcasing rich cultural heritage and traditional architecture.

name: Lake Victoria
description: Africa’s largest lake offering boat cruises, fishing, and beautiful scenic views along the shoreline.

name: Uganda Museum
description: The oldest museum in East Africa showcasing Uganda’s cultural, historical, and natural heritage.

name: Baháʼí Temple
description: The only Baháʼí House of Worship in Africa surrounded by peaceful gardens and panoramic city views.

name: Gaddafi National Mosque
description: A major religious landmark offering panoramic views of Kampala from its minaret.

name: Wandegeya Market
description: A vibrant local market filled with fresh produce, street food, and everyday Ugandan commerce.

name: Entebbe Botanical Gardens
description: A peaceful nature reserve with exotic plants, birds, and lakeside scenery.

name: Nakasero Market
description: A busy central market known for fruits, spices, and vibrant local trading culture.
